reviews.title: Easily the Most Premium and Well-Designed Case I’ve Ever Owned
reviews.comment: I’ve built a lot of PCs, and the ASUS ROG Hyperion GR701 is on a completely different level from any other case I’ve used. The moment you take it out of the box, you can feel how solid and overbuilt it is. The semi-open structure gives it a really aggressive, high-end look, and the airflow is excellent without needing a ton of extra adjustments. The tool-free side panels are one of my favorite things about this case — being able to open it instantly makes cable routing and upgrades way easier than on traditional cases. Inside, it has more space than you think. I was able to route cables cleanly, mount large radiators, and install everything without feeling cramped. Supporting dual 420mm radiators is a huge plus, especially for anyone running high-end CPUs and GPUs. The built-in GPU holder is also extremely helpful because modern graphics cards are heavy, and this keeps everything perfectly level with zero sag. The dual front Type-C ports are another small detail that make everyday use way more convenient. Overall, the Hyperion feels like it's designed by people who actually build PCs themselves. It’s sturdy, spacious, easy to work in, and looks amazing once everything is installed. If you’re building a high-end system and want a case that actually matches that level of quality and performance, this one is absolutely worth it.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: LOVE THIS CASE! (IT'S HUGE THOUGH)
reviews.comment: This case is AMAZING for me, however it is HUGE and HEAVY, so it definitely will not be for everyone. PROS: - High quality sturdy premium construction (I bought mine used/open box so it was less than MSRP, but if you need a big spacious high quality case it's worth the price) - HUGE inside that will fit everything you need and very easy DIY setup, it was my first build and everything worked the first time I powered it on - PLENTY of large 140mm fans for adequate cooling, 1 minor issue with the rear fan though you must pull it out in order to install your MOBO, and it will cover the top left side of it a little so it there's an LED screen it will be covered which is an odd design considering I installed an ASUS ROG Crosshair X870E Hero MOBO and the word CROSSHAIR was completely covered by the rear fan - Like I previously mentioned everything functioned properly right out of the box, you can choose to control your ARGB with the case itself or connect everything to your MOBO and control the ARGB with ASUS Armory Crate - Heavy duty aluminum construction feels very solid and scratch resistant, although the previous owner seemed to not know what they were doing and there were a few scratches on the inside and the glass led wall was all loose inside with some scratches as well (not visible with everything installed for me though) - I installed an ASUS Thor 1600W power supply in mine and even that big boy fit in no problem and even had connections to control it's ARGB with either the case or MOBO Overall very impressed and love this case! I hope they continue in this direction and the next case like this is even bigger and unique looking. It's for sure a head turner and friend's that see if always want to take a closer look, especially when it's on! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 FIVE STARS HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!
reviews.author: MVRK

reviews.title: ASUS 4 LIFE
reviews.comment: The ROG Hyperion GR701 BTF Edition is more than just a PC chassis—it’s a statement piece for serious builders who demand style, space, and cutting-edge airflow. With its Back-to-the-Future (BTF) layout, this case redefines build aesthetics by hiding cables and connectors behind the motherboard, delivering a sleek and ultra-clean presentation. Built with premium materials, the GR701 offers exceptional modularity and cooling performance. It supports E-ATX motherboards and massive GPU clearance, while its dual-chamber design keeps temperatures in check even with the most powerful components. Its generous internal space allows for ambitious custom loops or multiple fans and radiators, making it a dream for enthusiasts and overclockers. Every detail is thoughtfully crafted—from the integrated ARGB lighting and tool-less panels to the versatile front I/O placement. Whether you're showcasing the latest ROG components or creating a minimalist powerhouse, the GR701 BTF Edition turns your build into an art piece.
reviews.author: john alexander

reviews.title: Awesome Looking Case
reviews.comment: Case as well thought out. From installing graphics card and removing side plates(which need to remove the door for) to already preset cable management compartments that work well so that nobody notices. Plenty of area space all future proof upgrades. Thanks to the double doors on unit and glass even with noisy fans It seems quiet. Expensive keys, but you do get the cool factor would recommend for more experienced and intermediate PC builders.
